user_prompt: Compare common-only funding with the supplied preferred-equity financing. Keep project cash flows unchanged. Quantify initial sponsor cash saved, annual coupon arrears, terminal redemption shortfall, sponsor NPV and preferred-investor NPV. Stress distributable cash and exit proceeds. Do not infer deal terms from portfolio MW or MWh.
mandate: Use the existing finance role. Treat every term as synthetic, preserve evidence gaps, and reconcile distributions before accepting the output.
input_schema: case.json v1.0: nominal USD; annual nonnegative after-debt cash vector (1..50 years), terminal after-debt proceeds, total equity requirement, preferred capital <= requirement, coupon and discount in [0,1], fee <= preferred capital. HTTPS company announcement, ISO publication/event dates, terms_disclosed=false.
scheduler_prompt: Delegate evidence before finance. Reject unknown tasks/tools and premature finance execution. Never transfer funds, contact counterparties or change case inputs.
handoffs: Operator supplies explicitly assumed financing terms and after-debt cash
Evidence contract validates schema, classifications and missing information
Finance consumes isolated evidence-approved case and compares fixed project cash flows
Human verifies actual documents, tax treatment and senior covenants
output_contract: Common-only and preferred-funded sponsor NPV in USD
Preferred cash distributions, cumulative unpaid coupon and redemption shortfall
Investor/sponsor value transfer and transaction fee
Human review required, investment not authorized, LLM measurements unknown
acceptance: Annual cash equals coupon plus redemption plus common distribution
No preferred participation after coupons and terminal capital repayment
Missing terms remain visible; no actual transaction economics claimed
